steeringUnderTest:
Project conventions — testing

- Tests live under tests/ mirroring the package layout.
- All test files use the suffix _spec.py, never the test_ prefix convention.
- Use pytest; no unittest.TestCase subclasses.
- Each test asserts one behavior; name the test after the behavior, not the function.
- Fixtures go in conftest.py at the narrowest scope that works.
